verdict.rationale: Unstructured's processed output is a consistent, documented JSON format (with table HTML), results can be downloaded through the job APIs, and workflows send data from source to your own destinations, so the processed data you get back is in open formats. A community report that the official Docker image self-hosts easily also lowers lock-in. Nothing documents a complete account-level export or an exit process. Missing for 10: explicit export of all account data (workflow and connector configs, job history), documented account/data deletion or retention on leaving, independent corroboration of migrating off the platform.
